semantic_all49.shape: rows x fields; IDs < 918850 are static, IDs >= 918850 map to actor_id = ID - 918850
semantic_all49.selection: historical exporter saved total native alpha*T mass > .001
semantic_all49.semantic_gate: class_id already contains original total mass > .01 and semantic purity > .65; do not reapply gates to rounded float16
semantic_all49.precision: mass/fractions are saved float16; class_id is uint8; no full 20-class histogram or pixel-to-row weights saved here

r2_all49.role: historical selection membership only; no semantic/instance ground truth; nonmembership is not background proof

native_three_anchor.transmittance: actor-omitted frozen static alpha*T; do not mix numerically with full Actor10K semantic transmittance
native_three_anchor.saved_evidence_predicate: role > 0 OR bg_mass > .02; every row passing the present bg_mass > .05 dual-domain diagnostic must therefore be saved
native_three_anchor.precision: contribution scalars are float32; role and threshold results are historical proposals

background_three_anchor.role: independent visible LiDAR surface + stable original RGB/SH witness; all certified background flags false

surface_three_anchor.role: fixed query-world surface coverage; no source Gaussian/SH extrapolation outside49

actor_pose_all49.precision: float64 original actor-local to global-world rigid pose

native_shadow_all49.role: road receiver photo/effect evidence; never car semantic labels

full_geometry_local.coordinates: first-vehicle-local meters; xyz/rotation/scales are float32; native SHM/time-opacity still applies
full_geometry_local.role: all static rows available for CPU covariance inspection; displayed uint8 RGB is DC-only and cannot replace native SH

denominators.membership_policy: All49 historical selection events, independent of whether full-model semantic evidence was visible

parameters.two_domain_ranking: descending min(target_fraction, background_fraction); row ID resolves ties

parent_center_canonical_diagnostic.meaning: 只比较旧static父中心轨迹，不判定贡献表面归属；旧中心不随车不能证明其目标外观支撑不存在
parent_center_canonical_diagnostic.consequence: 后续canonical约束应施加于有真实深度/表面支持的子高斯，不把父中心直接硬绑到actor

route_npz.combined_count_array_layout: [0:918850] static, [918850:925091] Actor10K; array index is persistent branch row ID plus offset
route_npz.anchor_native_arrays: native_ids ordering; independent background arrays use row_export_ids ordering; missing semantic class=255

code_entries.exact_contribution: auxiliary-feature adjoint; sum-row mass closure checked by original GPU exporters
code_entries.original_decomposition: work/v43_gpu_20261028/train_target_unknown.py:Decomposition is whole-row gate/DC plus new background, not a two-child spatial split

limitations: 未观察的行/帧记missing；已观察但class_id=0记语义弃权；两者不作为car或noncar负标签。
R2 membership记录历史干预选择，不能作训练标签、GT、独立召回或精确率分母。
semantic full Actor10K与native_contact actor-omitted的alpha*T不同；本审计只按持久ID连接证据，不把质量数值直接相减。
同帧目标/背景双域贡献、跨帧语义冲突、背景几何+颜色冲突是三种不同观察，均不证明三维可分性。
背景/阴影候选均无完整human GT；source_shadow_state_unknown=true，certified_background=0。
本地只校验既有证据绑定和导出器checkpoint路径；没有重开远端checkpoint字节，也没有重新生成贡献。
三锚点是既有场景训练时刻；不是未见测试集。float16语义比例只能作已有证据的统计，不作新阈值精确重放。
